decision: Run competition-level trials before buying any feed. Sportmonks is the preferred football trial; Goalserve is the first priced multi-sport bundle to test; Sportradar is the enterprise benchmark. Use authoritative manual records for uncovered sports and never describe them as live.

acceptanceTests: current season and exact competition ID
authoritative schedule and Jerusalem time match
postponed, abandoned, extra-time and penalty status
separate women's, youth and lower-tier proof
stable transliteration with ILSP namebook override
website, app, alerts, newsletter and social display rights
logo and player-image rights or explicit exclusion
export, caching, retention, attribution and termination terms
seven-day parallel run with missing-event and latency log
footballRecapRequirements: exact home and away team identity with licensed marks or a rights-cleared fallback
attendance with authoritative evidence or explicit omission
confirmed eleven-player starting line-ups and coaches
goal scorers assistants minutes and running score
yellow second-yellow and red cards with player team and minute
substitutions and minutes when supplied by the authoritative record
possession shots shots on target and corners only when confirmed and licensed
VAR decisions overturns and post-match corrections
claim-specific verification URLs and last-confirmed time
recommendedNextAction: After owner approval, open bounded trials for Sportmonks and one multi-sport provider, run the competition-level acceptance suite, and obtain written display-rights terms before purchasing anything.
